svg.title: Official Microduck Walking environment scaling
svg.desc: 8192 environments gave the highest measured throughput among 4096, 8192 and 16384. The 32768 case is excluded because another GPU workload interfered. This is a capacity benchmark, not evidence of learned walking.
svg.title: Official Microduck Walking environment scaling

cc:Work.dc:title: Official Microduck Walking environment scaling
cc:Work.dc:description: Three uncontaminated native PPO environment counts on one GPU. Fourth count excluded due to shared GPU load. Capacity only.
